title: You Think Grit Means Staring Down Treats, Yet Hiding Them Stretched Patience Tenfold
description:
You think willpower means staring straight at temptation! Yet staring at treats broke kids right away! This is the true story of Walter Mischel's Stanford test. Here is what went wrong with old grit myths.
